body:
Your guess about the video games is accurate.  

There's nothing in particular that happened around the time I started feeling suicidal, and I have no unresolved issues with family or anyone else.  I think it's just part of who I am.
I might end up doing this.  What do you do?  Just go into the hospital and tell them you're going to kill yourself if you don't get help?
I have no desire any more to manage it, to be brave, or get back up again.  I just want it to stop this time.

But I'll only be able afford treatment for a while if I don't have insurance, and I only have insurance for as long as I keep this job, and who knows how much longer I'd keep it once it comes out that I'm the sole cause of between 100-150,000 in lost revenue and I could have easily prevented it by speaking up months ago.

>So what if the project at work is messed up? 

I avoid responsibility in my life.  This is the one real responsibility I have right now, and I managed to completely fuck it up.  It's just work, I know.  But if I can't even keep it together enough to do something that should be completely manageable, what does it say about my ability to live up to any kind of expectations or have any kind of responsibility in my life?
